summary: Ridge tower on the Tazewell-Buchanan county line, Virginia; register says built 1933, a 1929 newspaper item says already built. Standing; access limited.

access.note: The Register says access to the tower is limited.

events.note: Harrisonburg Daily News item dated October 28, 1929: a 62-foot steel tower has been built on Bearwallow Ridge. Conflicts with the register's 1933 build year.
Register build year; describes a 60-foot Aermotor tower. Conflicts with the 1929 item.

notes_for_editor: Two substantive sources: the NHLR entry and a 1929 newspaper item quoted on Forest Lookouts (the newspaper itself was not opened). Build year is unresolved: 1933 (register, 60 ft) against October 1929 (62 ft); the story says so and the record's height_m 18.9 follows the 62-foot figure. Record agency 'Arthur Stiltner' is the register's 'Administered by' line, a person rather than an agency; a human should decide the agency field. Nothing found on staffing, fires, present ownership or condition. A web search snippet said the Virginia Department of Forestry once ran the tower and it is now private, with standing recorded as of March 26, 2008; no page I could open states this, so it is not in the story or facts.
